source_discovery_scope: Interior buffer handle ownership and cache-publication policy
disposition: Scoped source discovery of InteriorLightingGpu buffer publication is complete: plugin setup retains a strong ShaderBuffer handle, interior and blood materials clone it, and targeted current application paths do not establish explicit removal or replacement of that handle. Strong ownership protects against ordinary drop; pinned Assets APIs still permit explicit removal or replacement. The uploader advances cached selection and data even when get_mut fails and does not react to same-ID replacement, so supported recovery semantics require an explicit policy. CPU diagnostics use cached data and do not prove GPU publication. No actual missing buffer, replacement, stale display or runtime failure is asserted.
alias_result: Keep unrelated field and shader contracts independently tracked.
remaining_after_discovery: After the complete audit gate decide whether asset removal/replacement is supported. If supported, retain pending state until upload succeeds and rebind cached materials when the handle changes; otherwise document and enforce the lifetime invariant. Validate missing, restored and replaced cases and keep unrelated lighting and native asset contracts separate.
